addMember.title: Add member
addMember.intro: Register a member from a paper application. Guardians can be members of the club, new people without login, or be invited by email.

addMember.birthDateHint: Give the birth date or the personal identity number (they must match if you give both).

addMember.guardianEmailHint: The email is used only for the invitation.
addMember.consentHint: Relatives, contact persons, step and foster parents need written consent, e.g. “Application form 2025-08-12”.
addMember.invitationEmail: Email for an invitation to log in (adults only)
addMember.invitationEmailHint: Never stored on the person; children never have an email.

activities.timeZoneHint: Times in the club's time zone ({zone}).

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.body: {club} (organisation number {organizationNumber}) is responsible for the personal data of its members, their guardians and its leaders. ClubAdmin processes the data on the club's behalf.

data.title: What we keep
data.body: Names, birth dates, the contact details you choose to share with the club, memberships, teams and groups, roles, answers to activities and attendance, registrations to events, and the consents you give.

purposes.title: Why
purposes.body: To run the club: membership, teams, activities, communication, annual reports and grant reports. Most of it is needed for your membership; what is optional is based on your consent.

consents.title: Consents
consents.body: The club asks for these consents: {purposes}. You give or withdraw each one separately, at any time, in ClubAdmin. Children under the consent age are represented by their guardians.

retention.title: How long
retention.body: After you leave the club we keep your contact details for {formerMemberMonths} months, then only your member number, your membership dates and type, your groups and roles remain. Answers and attendance are kept for {attendanceMonths} months after the activity. The audit log is kept for {auditMonths} months and the change history for {historyMonths} months. People without a login and without any connection to a club are deleted after {orphanMonths} months.

recipients.title: Who receives data
recipients.body: The sports federations the club belongs to, as their rules require, and ClubAdmin's suppliers of hosting, email and push notifications. Data is not sold.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may see the data the club holds about you, correct it, download it, have it deleted when it is no longer needed, object to processing and withdraw your consents. You may complain to the data protection authority.

protection.title: Privacy and protection
protection.name: Protected identity
protection.explain: If you have protected personal data (in Sweden: skyddade personuppgifter, sekretessmarkering or skyddad folkbokföring), or for another good reason, turn on protected identity.
protection.othersDont: Other members no longer see you anywhere: not in rosters, the register, activities or answers.
protection.whoSees: Your family, the club's managers and registrars and your own leaders still see you, with a crossed-out camera: they must not photograph, film, publish or share anything about you.
protection.addressDeleted: Any address stored about you is deleted and none can be stored.
protection.turnOffConsequences: Other members will see you again in rosters, the register and activities. You need to have logged in in the last 15 minutes.
protection.removalRefused: Only the guardian who turned it on can turn it off. Talk to the other guardian or to the club.
protection.protectYourself: Protect yourself too? Your name can reveal your child.
protection.guardianHint: Your child has protected identity, but you do not. Your name can reveal your child.
protection.addChildHint: Other members will not see the child, and no address is stored.
protection.accessLogIntro: Every time someone else opens the profile of a person with protected identity, or any profile in a club that logs every view, it is noted here: when, in which club and who.
protection.logEmpty: Nobody else has opened this profile.

protection.clubTurnedOn: The member is now protected in the club.
protection.clubHint: Use this when the family has told the club. A second factor is needed; every club manager is told (without the name).
protection.protectedMembersIntro: Members with protected identity, from the person or family or set in the club. Brief the leaders: no photos, films, publishing or sharing.
protection.modeHint: When every view is logged, each member can see who opened their profile, and the profile pages say so. Views of protected members are always logged.
protection.viewsLogged: Views of profiles are logged: the person can see who opened their profile.
protection.helpWhat: A crossed-out camera next to a name means that the person has protected identity. Some families have protected personal data, for example because someone is at risk: then where they are and who they are with must not spread.
protection.helpRules: Do not photograph or film the person, do not publish or share pictures, names or results, and do not tell others where and when they train or play.
protection.helpLeaders: As a leader you see the person so you can run your group. Others in the club do not see them. If you are unsure, ask the club's managers.
protection.helpView: Opening the profile of a person with protected identity is logged: the person and their guardians can see who did.

billing.cardHint: Card details are entered on the payment provider's page; ClubAdmin never sees them. Invoices are charged when issued; the due date and reminders are the same as for invoices.
billing.cardSaved: Thank you. The card is saved as soon as the payment provider confirms it (usually within a minute).
billing.paidThanks: Thank you for the payment. It is shown as soon as the payment provider confirms it.
